name: Patrasche
description: Patrasche is a loyal, proud female black Diana earth dragon gifted to Natsuki Subaru by Crusch Karsten for his contributions during the White Whale subjugation in Arc 3. Unconditionally devoted to Subaru, she has risked her life repeatedly to protect him throughout the Sanctuary trials in Arc 4 and the dunes of the Pleiades Watchtower in Arc 6.
